They filled the bronze vessels to the brim. He made the @fsux{tilimda} vessels shine like the holy barge, …… fine chickpea flour, bearded carp ……. ……, he …… fish like dates. Many followed @wPN{Gudam} on the streets of @wSN{Unug}. They sat armed before him. Her @noteref{= @wDN{Inana's}} singer @wPN{Lugal-gabaŋal} came out to ……, and looked at the troops. The singer met him with a song, …… string with his hand:

@q[,Gudam]{“What you have eaten, what you have eaten -- it was not bread that you have eaten, it was your flesh that you have eaten! What you have drunk, what you have drunk -- it was not beer that you drank, it was your blood that you drank! @wPN{Gudam}, many followed you on the streets of @wSN{Unug}; they sat armed before you.”}

@q[Gudam,]{“…… what the woman ordered me, when I have …….”} @wPN{Gudam} slapped his thigh with his fist in annoyance; fear overcame him: @q[Gudam,]{“He did not grasp the Šar-ur, my heroic weapon. For me the temple of @wSN{Zabalam} …….”}

He lopped off the crossbeams of @wTN{E-ana} as if they were branches. @wPN{Gudam} went out into the street. @wPN{Gudam} crushed many on the streets of @wSN{Unug}, and killed many with his mace. @varh[t134.v1]{He hacked down the door of the city gate } @vart[t134.v2,t134.v1]{@varn{the other ms. has instead:} …… the gate, the gate of @wDN{Iškur} }. @q[Gudam,Inana]{“@wDN{Inana}, spare my life! I will give you bulls of the mountains, I will make your cow-pen full! I will give you sheep of the mountains, I will make your sheepfold full!”}

Inana, I will speak of your heroism. It is pleasant to praise you!
